purpose: Pin and scope the preserved raw JobLevel stat field slice for the currently admitted normal Hero 6 and 8 JobConnections.

artifact.extractionRule: Project the listed fields from each exact JobLevelInfo ID enumerated by ConfigDataJobConnectionInfo.JobLevels_ID for Hero 6 connections 60-65 and Hero 8 connections 80-85; preserve Source values and field presence without defaults.

claimScope: Raw ConfigDataJobLevel stat fields for every JobLevel_ID explicitly referenced by the 12 normal JobConnections of Hero 6 and 8. Values remain Job/JobLevel source facts; no Hero-level, Star, Hero-rank modifier, formula, mastery, bond effect, derived stat, or final combat stat is asserted. The selected 50 records contain DEX_INI but no DEX_UP field; no Dexterity growth value is inferred.
limitations: Only the explicitly referenced JobLevel records for Hero 6 and 8 normal JobConnections are included.
JobLevelUpHeroLevel and rank_code are retained as source fields; no broader progression formula is claimed.
DEX_UP is absent in the selected source rows; no Dexterity growth value is inferred.
Hero-level/star scaling, global Job mastery, bond effects, final stats and derived combat outputs are out of scope.
